function.name: get_headway
function.description: Calculates the headway, which is the distance from the front of the ego vehicle to the closest leading object, using curvilinear coordinates. This function requires the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes from perception data.

ego_info.description: Information about the ego vehicle, including its position and orientation.

position.description: Curvilinear coordinates of the ego vehicle, consisting of lateral and longitudinal positions.

lateral.description: Lateral position of the ego vehicle in meters. This is a float type value.

longitudinal.description: Longitudinal position of the ego vehicle in meters. This is a float type value.

orientation.description: Orientation of the ego vehicle in degrees. This is a float type value.

lane_id.description: Unique identifier for the detected lane.

bounding_boxes.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing detected objects. Each bounding box should include dimensions and the object's position relative to the ego vehicle.

function.name: get_time_headway
function.description: Calculates the time headway (THW), which is the time it will take for the ego vehicle to reach the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates. Inputs include the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes of the perceived objects.

ego_info.description: Contains the ego vehicle's current position and velocity.

position.description: The vehicle's current position as a tuple of x, y, and z coordinates (meters).

items.description: This is a float type value.

velocity.description: The vehicle's current velocity in meters per second (m/s). This is a float type value.

lane_info.description: Information about the detected lane, including its curvature and width.

curvature.description: The curvature of the lane at the ego vehicle's position (1/meters). This is a float type value.

width.description: The width of the lane in meters (m). This is a float type value.

bboxes.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing perceived objects. Each bounding box is described by its position and size.

items.description: This is a float type value.

velocities.description: List of velocities of the detected objects in meters per second (m/s).

items.description: This is a float type value.

accelerations.description: List of accelerations of the detected objects in meters per second squared (m/s^2).

function.name: get_time_to_collision
function.description: Calculates the time it will take for the ego vehicle to collide with the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates, considering both vehicles' velocities and the leading object's acceleration.

ego_velocity.description: The current velocity of the ego vehicle in meters per second. This is a float type value.

ego_acceleration.description: The current acceleration of the ego vehicle in meters per second squared. This is a float type value.

leading_object_velocity.description: The current velocity of the leading object in meters per second. This is a float type value.

leading_object_acceleration.description: The current acceleration of the leading object in meters per second squared. This is a float type value.

initial_distance.description: The initial distance between the ego vehicle and the leading object in meters. This is a float type value.

function.name: get_sensor_alerts
function.description: Retrieve a paginated list of sensor alerts within a specified timespan and optionally filtered by various criteria such as network IDs or sensor metrics.

perPage.description: The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 100.

startingAfter.description: A server-generated token indicating the start of the page, such as a timestamp or an ID.

endingBefore.description: A server-generated token indicating the end of the page, such as a timestamp or an ID.

t0.description: The start of the timespan for the data, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). The maximum lookback period is 365 days from today.

t1.description: The end of the timespan for the data, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., '2023-12-31T23:59:59Z'). t1 can be a maximum of 365 days after t0.

networkId.description: A list of network IDs to filter the returned data.

timespan.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched in seconds. Do not specify if t0 and t1 are provided. Must be less than or equal to 31,536,000 seconds (365 days).

sensorSerial.description: The sensor serial number to filter the returned data.

triggerMetric.description: Filter alerts triggered by a specific metric.

function.name: get_sensor_readings_latest
function.description: Retrieves the most recent readings for each metric from each sensor, organized by the sensor's serial number.

perPage.description: Specifies the number of entries per page. Must be within the range of 3 to 100.

startingAfter.description: The server-generated token marking the start of the page. Typically a timestamp or ID. If omitted, the server will provide the default starting point.

endingBefore.description: The server-generated token marking the end of the page. Typically a timestamp or ID. Optional; if omitted, the server will provide the default ending point.

networkId.description: Filters the returned data by network IDs. If omitted, data for all networks is returned.

serials.description: Filters readings by sensor serial numbers. If omitted, readings for all sensors are returned.

metrics.description: Specifies the types of sensor readings to retrieve, such as 'temperature', 'humidity', or 'co2'. If omitted, all available types of readings are retrieved.

function.name: get_sensor_readings_history_by_interval
function.description: Retrieves historical sensor readings within a specified timespan, summarized in intervals, and returns them sorted by the start time of each interval in descending order.

perPage.description: Number of entries per page, within the range of 3 to 100.

startingAfter.description: Server-generated token indicating the start of the page, typically a timestamp or ID.

endingBefore.description: Server-generated token indicating the end of the page, typically a timestamp or ID.

networkId.description: Filter data by the specified network IDs.

serials.description: Filter readings by sensor serial numbers.

metrics.description: Specify sensor reading types to retrieve, such as 'temperature', 'humidity', 'pressure'. Defaults to all available types if not supplied.

timespan.description: The timespan for fetching data, in seconds. The maximum is equivalent to 730 days and 12 hours.

t0.description: Start of the data timespan, in the ISO 8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. The maximum lookback period is 730 days and 12 hours.

t1.description: End of the data timespan, in the ISO 8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. This can be a maximum of 730 days and 12 hours after t0.

interval.description: The time interval in seconds for the data returned. Valid values are 15, 120, 300, 900, 3600, 14400, 86400, or 604800.

models.description: Filter readings by one or more sensor models. Available models include 'MT10', 'MT11', 'MT12', 'MT14', 'MT20', 'MT30'.
